Solid foundation with specific dimensions requiring attention. Proactive development recommended.

dimension_verdicts.meaning: Emerging mandate capability with targeted development needs

archetypes.name: The Envoy
archetypes.failure_pattern: Great on paper, fails in practice because relationships don't form. The mandate dies from isolation.

archetypes.name: The Navigator
archetypes.failure_pattern: Misunderstands what the role actually requires. Misaligned expectations create early friction.

archetypes.name: The Chameleon
archetypes.failure_pattern: Says all the right things in the wrong way. Message is right but delivery creates friction.

archetypes.name: The Anchor
archetypes.failure_pattern: Starts strong, deteriorates under sustained pressure. The mandate doesn't fail in good times — it fails in the first crisis.

archetypes.name: The Sprinter
archetypes.failure_pattern: Wins short-term results but burns long-term relationship capital. The board sees Q1 wins and doesn't notice the damage.

archetypes.name: The Cultural Operator
archetypes.failure_pattern: The ideal BRIDGE profile. Strong across all dimensions with cultural fluency as a demonstrated strength.
